originalPrompt:
Create a premium landscape pixel-art mechanical creature concept sheet for an original top-down mobile action game, titled "LODESTAR / 03". It is a static workshop design board, not gameplay footage. An articulated magnetic industrial serpent: exactly SIX connected main rigid bodies: ONE broad wedge-shaped split-jaw head, FOUR armored induction carriages, ONE tapered telescoping tail. Five short strong universal-joint couplings with real hinge bearings, copper bus bars and flexible cables connect the six bodies. Compact heavy grounded roller bogies under the sides of each carriage; this machine travels along the ground, NOT airborne, no legs, no wings, no jet engines, no gun barrels, no missiles, no humanoid face. Each induction carriage contains a clearly separate copper concentric flywheel and restrained cold teal-white core visible through its opening iris armor. Thick worn dark iron and muted olive armor with pale ceramic inserts and old copper mechanisms. Body bends into a broad open S, plausible joint limits, no disconnected floating body chunks. Head carries two short articulated arms with crescent-shaped metal cutting tools on pivot bearings. Mid-body has two small induction-pole docking bays; tail ends in a visibly telescoping three-stage industrial lance. All machinery must have clear attachments and substantial material weight. Distinct readable silhouette, not a dragon or a centipede with many legs.

Layout: left 65% one large beautiful three-quarter overhead hero view of the whole SAME six-body machine posed calmly on dark cracked concrete, entire tail and head in frame, soft contact shadow. Right 35% clean charcoal workshop panel with a smaller TRUE TOP VIEW of exactly the same six-body machine in a gentle bend, and an orderly exploded module strip showing head, one representative carriage, joint coupling, induction pole, crescent tool and telescoping tail. Bottom right two small tail diagrams show retracted versus extended. Labels only "TOP VIEW", "MODULAR PARTS", "TAIL / EXTEND". No paragraphs, rulers or stats, no extra decorative robot variants. Crisp deliberate pixel edges, detailed but legible material shading suitable for a large boss in a mobile pixel shooter. Neutral overhead light, limited warm highlights, cold teal-white energy is a small accent not neon bloom. Sophisticated art direction and tidy board spacing. No HUD, watermark, logos, people or combat scene. This is an identity study, not a ready-to-cut sprite atlas.
refinementPrompt: Correct this Lodestar design board with ONE precise assembly correction. Preserve all art direction, palette, typography, head, crescent arms, coupling hardware, tail and the modular-parts and tail-extend panels. The hero assembled machine and the TOP VIEW currently have only THREE circular-core induction carriages between head and tail. BOTH assembled views must show exactly FOUR circular-core induction carriages between the head and tail: HEAD + FOUR CORE CARRIAGES + TAIL = SIX rigid bodies and FIVE short couplings. Add one matching core carriage just before the tail in each assembled view, expanding the pose within its panel to keep the entire machine in frame with natural broad joint bends. Count four visible copper-ring teal-white core carriages in each assembled view. Every body physically connected. Keep the original proportions of each part; do not merge two carriages into a long body or add any other modules. Keep lower right modular parts as representative single parts, not a repeated full inventory. No new text.
status: Identity concept for review; not runtime parts or an atlas.
